title: 第十四章风雨欲来
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
那青年穿着外门特有的青色劲装，袖口绣着两把交叉的小剑。

    他没看那些推车的杂役，径直朝废阁门口走来。

    每走一步，周围的空气就沉重一分。

    叶凡站在门槛边，胸口猛地一闷。

    这感觉太熟悉了。灵压。

    没有刻意外放，仅仅是自然流露的气息，就压得周围几个杂役双腿打颤，连头都不敢抬，推完车赶紧缩到一边，恨不得把脑袋塞进裤裆里。

    叶凡体内的气血本能地想要反抗。一转之后的肉身强悍无比，这点灵压根本压不垮他。

    但他硬生生把那股反抗的劲儿憋了回去。

    肩膀一垮，膝盖一弯，叶凡顺势靠在破门框上，装出喘不过气来的样子，脸色憋得通红，双腿还配合着微微发抖。

    装孙子这门手艺，他在杂役峰练了八十年，早就刻进骨子里了。

    青年停在三步外。视线落在叶凡脸上，上下扫了两遍。

    “你就是叶凡？”

    声音不大，却震得叶凡耳膜嗡嗡直响。

    叶凡赶紧点头，腰弯得更低了，双手在身前局促地搓着。

    “是，我是叶凡。这位师兄，您有什么吩咐？”

    青年没接话，盯着他那张年轻的脸看。

    “马得水说你返老还童了，我本来不信，一个九十岁的凡人老头，半截身子都埋进土里了，怎么可能一夜之间变回壮年。”

    青年往前迈了半步。

    “说说吧，怎么回事？”

    叶凡心里暗骂马得水这肥猪嘴真快，脸上却堆起苦笑，满脸懊恼地拍了一下大腿。

    “师兄明鉴啊！我哪知道怎么回事，昨天我在这废丹洞里干活，饿得头晕眼花。”

    “洞里黑灯瞎火的，我闻到一股怪香味，顺着找过去，在石头缝里摸到个红彤彤的果子。”

    叶凡咽了口唾沫，演得极其逼真，还故意把领口扯开一点，露出锁骨上沾着的黑泥。

    “我当时饿疯了，抓起来就塞嘴里。结果那果子一下肚，疼得我满地打滚，直接晕死过去。今天早上爬起来去水坑边一照，就变成这副鬼样子了。”

    叶凡指着自己的鼻子，一副吃大亏的倒霉样。

    “不仅变年轻了，我之前好不容易攒的那点修为，全掉光了！”

    青年没出声。

    一股无形的力量突然钻进叶凡体内。

    叶凡没躲。

    他清楚这是凝气期修士的灵气探查。

    他大大方方地敞开经脉，把锻体七阶的修为死死锁在九龙搬血重塑的骨血深处，只留下一层薄薄的锻体一阶灵气在表面游荡。

    那股探查的力量在叶凡经脉里转了一圈，很快退了出去。
content_en:
The young man was wearing a cyan outfit unique to the outer sect, with two crossed swords embroidered on his sleeves.

    He didn't look at the handymen pushing the carts and walked straight towards the entrance of the abandoned pavilion.

    With every step he took, the air around him became heavier.

    Ye Fan stood at the threshold, his chest suddenly felt tight.

    This feels all too familiar. Reiatsu.

    There was no sudden release, just the natural aura, which made the legs of several handymen around him tremble, and they didn't even dare to raise their heads. After pushing the cart, they quickly shrank to the side, wishing they could stuff their heads into their crotches.

    The blood in Ye Fan's body instinctively wanted to resist. After the transformation, his physical body was extremely powerful, and this little bit of spiritual pressure could not crush him at all.

    But he forcefully suppressed his resistance.

    His shoulders slumped and his knees bent, Ye Fan leaned against the broken door frame, pretending to be out of breath, his face turned red from holding back, and his legs were trembling slightly.

    The art of pretending to be a grandson has been engraved in his bones for eighty years after he practiced it at Zaoyufeng.

    The young man stopped three steps away. His eyes fell on Mark's face and he scanned it up and down twice.

    "Are you Ye Fan?"

    The sound was not loud, but it made Ye Fan's eardrums buzz.

    Ye Fan nodded quickly, bent even lower, and rubbed his hands nervously in front of him.

    "Yes, I am Ye Fan. Senior brother, what are your orders?"

    The young man didn't answer and stared at his young face.

    "Ma Deshui said that you have rejuvenated. I didn't believe it at first. How could a ninety-year-old mortal man with half of his body buried in the earth return to his prime overnight?"

    The young man took half a step forward.

    "Tell me, what's going on?"

    Ye Fan secretly scolded Ma Deshui for being such a fast-talking fat pig, but a bitter smile appeared on his face and he patted his thigh with annoyance.

    "Senior brother Mingjian! I don't know what's going on. I was working in this useless pill cave yesterday and I was so hungry that I felt dizzy."

    "The cave was dimly lit, and I smelled a strange fragrance. I followed it and found a red fruit in the cracks of the rocks."

    Ye Fan swallowed and acted extremely realistically. He even deliberately opened his collar a little to reveal the black mud on his collarbone.

    "I was so hungry that I grabbed the fruit and stuffed it into my mouth. As a result, the fruit hit my stomach and made me roll on the floor in pain, and I fainted. This morning I got up and took a photo by the puddle, and it turned into this ghost look."

    Ye Fan pointed at his nose, looking like he had suffered a big loss.

    "Not only have I become younger, but all the cultivation I had managed to accumulate before has been lost!"

    The young man said nothing.

    An invisible force suddenly penetrated Ye Fan's body.

    Ye Fan didn't hide.

    He knew that this was the spiritual energy exploration of the monks in the Qi Condensation Stage.

    He generously opened his meridians and locked the seventh-level cultivation of the body in the depths of the bones and blood reshaped by Jiulong's blood, leaving only a thin layer of the first-level aura of the body wandering on the surface.

    The probing power circulated in Ye Fan's meridians and quickly retreated.
